name: Morozov-SH Core (Modified)
description: This version of Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems' Morozov-SH core has been modified from its original form. Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining based on their recommendation; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart.
